heading: "Your Total Security Professional"
html:
Service Portfolio

"Your Total Security Professional"

Comprehensive, professional, and responsive protection solutions tailored to your specific operational needs.

Event Staffing

Specialized staffing for large and small events, with custom services tailored to schools, businesses, and community venues.

Learn More →

School Security

Professional security and protection for school districts across the region, with NASRO-certified full-time staff.

Learn More →

Security Guards

Armed and unarmed guards for public and private settings. Short-term, long-term, and permanent security services available 24/7.

Learn More →

ACT 67 Certified Services

An approved and authorized ACT 67 vendor, providing security services tailored to Pennsylvania’s school safety requirements.

Learn More →

Private Investigations

Professional surveillance and investigative techniques to gather accurate information and uncover facts for local and national cases.

Learn More →

In-Home Security

Wireless alarm systems customized to your home or business, with user-friendly features and support from a community-oriented team.

Learn More →

Security Checks

Home and business security checks while you are on vacation, traveling for work, or away for an extended period.

Learn More →

First Aid Training

Customized CPR, First Aid, and AED training for businesses, facilities, civic groups, and private groups.

Learn More →

Vehicle Patrol

Custom patrol services using marked and unmarked vehicles, covert vehicles, and security golf carts suited to your venue.

Learn More →

Logistical Security

Security and logistical services for the transportation industry across Eastern Pennsylvania’s I-78 corridor.

Learn More →

Armed Security

Specialized armed guard services with full-time personnel trained in firearms use and certified by NASRO.

Learn More →

Warehouses & Distribution Centers

Security programs built around the unique challenges and operational concerns of warehouses and distribution centers.

Learn More →

Event Traffic Control

Traffic control and safety services for events of all sizes across Pennsylvania, from small gatherings to major public events.

Learn More →

Process Services

Service of subpoenas, summons, complaints, and other court documents in accordance with local guidelines.

Learn More →

Fire Watch

Site-specific fire watch protection that addresses local code requirements when commercial safety systems are not in operation.

Learn More →

Armed Money Escorts

Armed escort services focused on vigilance, attention to detail, and the protection and safety of our customers.

Learn More →

Quality, Licensed Security at Competitive Rates

As we continue to expand across Pennsylvania, we remain committed to integrity, readiness, and tailored solutions that meet evolving security needs. Our goal is to set the benchmark for safety, service, and trust by providing reliable, effective, and forward-thinking protection.

KRE Security, LLC will always be “Your Total Security Professional,” prepared for today’s demands and tomorrow’s challenges.

heading: 5 Benefits of Hiring a Security Company
html:
TACTICAL ADVANTAGE

5 Benefits of Hiring a Security Company

01

Sense of Security

Even just the presence of a security guard can make a business more effective and efficient by giving the owners and employees peace of mind.

02

Prevention

A thief will think twice when there is a security guard present. It lets them know that you are serious about the security of your business and will deter them from targeting you.

03

Customer Service

Not only does a sense of security put your employees at ease but also your customers.

04

Handling Crime

Having a security guard will deter crime in your business but it may still happen; having security measures in place will allow police to solve a crime quickly and get you back to business in no time!

05

Monitoring

Take this responsibility off of your shoulders and leave your business security to a professional security guard company.

Field Operations

Protection Excellence

24/7
Readiness
100%
Compliance
